'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 James Barnes DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[James Barnes]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' JCBR13
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
